# E13 build plan

Planning artifact, not implementation approval. The senior plan review precedes code. The frozen design is unchanged.

## Baseline and build order

At planning time `hub/`, `ui/`, `eval/`, generated hub contracts and the five E13 runtime configuration files do not exist. `contracts/` and `config/` contain pharmacy artifacts only. `docs/requests/E13.md` and `docs/tdd/reviews/E13.*` are absent, so there is no E13 cold-review verdict or response to treat as resolved. The embedded R-E13-1 through R-E13-15 proposals in `docs/tdd/E13.md:927` have not been canonically filed. Independent plan review and the coordinator handoffs below remain prerequisites, not waived gates.

All task source files come from the finite inventory in `docs/tdd/E13.md:903`. Test subdirectories partition its `hub/tests/assistant/**` grant. The UI task owns only its assistant feature directory. Other epic designs' section 13 inventories and every available `docs/build/*/tasks.json` were checked for assistant ownership. Recheck at dispatch because other planners are adding plans concurrently. Never edit provider files, configuration, generated code, the shell, fixtures or shared tooling.

| Task | Concern and owned area | Starts after |
|---|---|---|
| T1 | Pure domain, application ports and DTOs; domain tests | E01 kernel/generated enums/fakes; C1 and C2 decisions |
| T2 | SQLite repositories, sole migration, runtime lifecycle and recovery; persistence tests | T1; E01 storage/tasks and C1/C3/C4 |
| T3 | Assessment verification/application and assessment HTTP router; assessment tests | T2; agreed E10/E11/E12/E15/E28 bindings |
| T4 | Insight application and HTTP router; insight tests | T2; agreed E03/E12/E24 bindings |
| T5 | Conversation controller, continuations, help/benchmark adapters, stream and assistant HTTP router; controller tests | T3 and T4; C1/C2/C3 bindings |
| T6 | Seven designed Vue components, feature tests and all E13 real-stack acceptance | T5 for acceptance; UI can start against generated examples once E03 shell contracts exist |

T3 and T4 run in parallel. T1 freezes only already agreed application interfaces; it cannot invent repository protocols or DTO fields for the other coders. T2 implements persistence once C2 settles those missing declarations. T5 is the single integration author, so assessment and insight coders never edit its loop/router/stream files. The coordinator supplies the missing registration artifact under C1; no task claims that unlisted file. No task builds the model client, tool gateway, acquisition adapter, warning engine, help engine, plan engine or evaluation harness.

Hard dependencies are E01, E02, E11, E12 and E27-guidance, exactly `docs/SYSTEM.md:2364`. E04/E10/E15/E17/E24/E26 add their documented capabilities. Component work uses their published port protocols and E01 `kernel.testing`, never an invented provider. Missing ports or mandatory validation block that capability. Production never binds a test fake. Acceptance waits for the actual providers needed by each scenario, including E21's frozen fixture and E17's documented stub. A safe disabled interim does not pass the positive acceptance case.

## Connection and transaction boundary

`openConversation` and `sendMessage` admit one durable turn per conversation. E01 `TaskQueue` records its identity and pins in the same transaction as E13 state. `startAssessment` admits the public `assessment` kind; ordinary turns expose no public Job. E17 runs inference and E12 stages tools outside hub write transactions. E01 `TaskHandler.apply` owns the completion transaction: current session/object/field access, source revisions, E11 token, cancellation generation, policy and guidance eligibility are checked before effects and verified output commit together. Only committed, currently authorized text reaches `streamConversation`. These are SYSTEM sections 5.7, 5.8, 5.10.1, 5.12 and 8.1 to 8.3, not E13 implementations of shared mechanisms.

An actual result, not request acceptance, triggers continuation. Unsupported claims are withheld. Questions, choices, missing items, habitat facts, citations and plan text come from pinned configuration or owner ports. All stored clinical values retain units, source, observation time and origin. No journal, raw report, thinking, rejected model text or other person's chart enters assistant context, generic caches, logs or exports.

## End to end evidence

T6 owns `hub/tests/assistant/e2e/`, within the frozen test grant. Every row below is a separate collected scenario with its listed IDs, using normal `create_app(settings)` composition and real SQLite in a temporary directory. Browser assertions use Playwright against that same running hub. No dependency overrides, mocked repositories, fake in-hub services, direct SQL seeding or test-only production branches. Only documented external E17 scripts and absent optional workers are permitted. Fault injection uses E01's documented storage/process seams. If a required provider or observation facility is absent, the scenario remains blocked and fails acceptance.

| Scenario | IDs and required proof |
|---|---|
| Intake to actual outcome | E13-01, R17/R28, D05/D06/D30, V01/V78: red flags precede all observed model invocations; ECG unavailable produces request plus unresolved gap/form link without a task; pulse request has reason/decision/kit card; actual accepted outcome resumes once. Handoff retains Not available here. Run with devices absent and manual alternative; camera success/refusal uses E06's documented external fake when available, never relabel manual as camera. |
| Grounded assessment | E13-02, R16, V23, D10/D11: nonexistent/unseen/failed support never displays; all retained references resolve at their exact pin; four assessment sections and kit gap render. Required semantic support pass can remove a plausible but unsupported claim even when its citation exists. D10 remains blocked pending C5's passage representation. |
| Scope and private canaries | V25/V26, R17/R28, INV-E13-07/15: cross-person tool request terminates; owner B, station and an ungranted officer cannot read owner A's results, jobs, streams or events. E21 journal canary and E17 thinking canary stay out of assistant records, prompts, retrieval, logs and exports. Inspect only authorized synthetic evaluation evidence with a completeness watermark. Repeat after grant revocation. |
| Cancellation and incomplete work | E13-03, V27: slow/no-token/malformed model, bounded repair, cancel and completion race; no speculative effect or late-generation publication; deterministic incomplete assessment visible on timeout; help and cancel remain usable. Killing/restarting the real hub and filling the test filesystem preserve accepted records/receipts and fence old results. Recovery expectation follows SYSTEM, not legacy automatic failure. |
| Honest uncertainty | E13-01/02/03, V28/V34: all useful tests unavailable or declined, including an unsupplied benchmark lab, stop with gaps and supported next step; no fabricated Observation. No evidence/embedding worker yields the documented labeled fallback. |
| Corrected facts | V30, INV-E13-02: corrections before the next step and immediately before apply prevent publication; stored assessments become stale through E15. Preserve both disagreeing accepted readings, unknown/declined answers, original observed times and SIM/LIVE/REPLAY partitions. Forward/backward clock corrections and mission-day boundaries never overwrite newer state. Primary-guard removal tests belong to component tests; the HTTP test uses all real guards. |
| Guarded help | R15/R28, V63/D25: fixed steps appear first with model stopped and under inference load; one question at a time after restart, anchored to pinned flow/kit; medicine proposal rejected/audited/absent; node change/close rejects late text. Unreviewed but sourced eligible content has its review label. Incapacitated subject gets fixed help without a new chart grant. |
| Insight authority | R40, V65/D17 and V10: valid own SIM support, pattern/advice only, at most watch, no routine task; Act proposal and CO2 clear proposal denied/audited; rule/sensor warning unchanged. Habitat REPLAY is a separate dated fact with hub text, never personal exposure. Dismiss/expiry affect only the linked assistant warning. |
| Whole day without model | V69 and V01, R15: daily check, routine, rule/sensor warnings, fixed help, records and authorized sharing work with model stopped, every device absent and ground down; no new insight; card shows stopped. Existing assistant warning lifecycle still works. |
| Critical-path faults and configuration | Charter section 6, INV-E13-01/05/06/11: duplicate intents including after 24 hours and changed target/body, concurrent sends, admission limits, storage/audit failure before and after commit, corrupt/missing config and last-good activation, changed non-safety copy/topic, long ground outage and reconnection. Accepted input remains durable; no assistant contact is queued; warnings/routine misses unchanged; configured content changes without code. |

Unit/component IDs from `docs/tdd/E13.md:832` are allocated once: T1 gets 001/002/014/021/042/046/071/075; T2 gets 020/060/065/076/083; T3 gets 030 to 034/040/041/043/045/047/048/049; T4 gets 070/072/073/074/081; T5 gets 010 to 013/015 to 019/022 to 028/035/050 to 053/061 to 063/066/067/080/092; T6 gets 044/064/082/090/091/093/094 and the expanded scenarios above. T6 also owns the marked 095/096 reference measurements. These measure actual latency/RSS on the stated machine and never replace functional or CI gates. E21 registers these acceptance nodes in its runner under C7; until then the design's eval gate remains outstanding.

All task gate commands are future execution requirements using SYSTEM section 6 conventions. None was run against nonexistent implementation. Zero collected tests, missing tools/providers or unsupported positive scenarios cannot count as pass. Broad final gates include 95% branch coverage on domain/application, complete traceability, generated contract validation, UI checks, fault/contract/e2e CI jobs and independent review. Gate defects are coordinator requests, never suppressed failures.
